bio: Punchcutter who helped N. C. Kelkar improve the Kesari type in Poona. Son of Sahadevrao Pimple, the original punch-maker of the Kesari type foundry.

sources.title: Typography of Devanagari, Volume Two, p. 477 (Bapurao S. Naik)
sources.publisher: Directorate of Languages, Government of Maharashtra
